Cookie Policy

Last updated: 7 May 2026

The short version

[ STATUS: CLEAN ] — This site does not use advertising cookies, tracking cookies, or analytics cookies. No cookie consent banner required.

What we use instead: localStorage

We use your browser's localStorage (not cookies) to save your exercise progress and access tokens. This is a technical mechanism built into every browser. The data stored this way:

  • → Never leaves your device
  • → Is not accessible to us or any third party
  • → Can be deleted at any time from your browser settings
  • → Does not require consent under GDPR

Third-party services

Stripe (payment processor) and Formspree (email forms) may set their own cookies when you interact with their services. Please review their respective cookie policies for details.

How to clear your data

In any browser: Settings → Privacy → Clear browsing data → Local storage. This will reset your progress and access tokens.
